title: pr-agent Repository Override Config
description: Optional, checked-in per-repository file (.github/pr-agent.config.json) overriding pr-agent's organisation-wide defaults for review-budget thresholds and the approved branch-prefix list. Absent by default. Assignee and base branch are never configured here — both are resolved dynamically at invocation time.

reviewBudget.description: Overrides for the review-size thresholds. Any field omitted falls back to the organisation-wide default.

preferredFiles.description: Default: 15. Files above this count are noted as exceeding the preferred budget.

preferredLines.description: Default: 400. Lines above this count are noted as exceeding the preferred budget.

hardFlagFiles.description: Default: 25. Files above this count require a stacked PR set or a documented maintainer exception.

hardFlagLines.description: Default: 800. Lines above this count require a stacked PR set or a documented maintainer exception.

maxStackSize.description: Default: 5. Maximum PRs in a single stack before it should be split under an epic.

approvedPrefixes.description: Default: this repository's own constitution.md 'Branch Type to PR Template Routing' table (38 types). Set only to document an intentional, narrower or repository-specific list — never to work around a naming mistake.
